PLAN · nave 8.4 × 5.4 m, two vault bays
The richest room in the Age: altarpiece,
plate, reliquary — and five windows that
shatter at a thrown ewer and wake the
whole house (glass is the loudest thing
IGNIS: the frontal and the benches burn;
